title: Timic State-Transition Formula Ledger
purpose: Preserve project formulae that are genuinely formula-like but expressed as ordered symbolic transitions rather than numerical equations. These are state-machine and narrative formalisms, not physical equations unless separately modeled.

formulas.formula: homogeneous plane → rupture → opening → center → axis → communication between levels → reoriented world
formulas.formal_reading: state/configuration sequence through threshold and structural reorientation

formulas.formula: entity → relation; person → function; climber → path; wisdom → structure; center → axis
formulas.formal_reading: change of object type/function rather than simple translation in a fixed space

formulas.formula: source → life → world → death → memory → renewal → life
formulas.formal_reading: closed symbolic cycle with changed-state return

formulas.formula: Spiral = dynamic form of Tree; Tree = organic form of Axis; Axis = geometric form of Ladder; Ladder = experiential form of Door; Door = crossing of separation; Potato = buried material form of renewal
formulas.warning: These are functional projections/analogies, not mathematical identities in one common codomain.

formulas.formula: abstraction → relation; memory → responsibility; potential → manifestation; burial → sprouting; fragmentation → connection; karma → topology
Son → death → Door/Vessel → buried potential → interval → Turning → Sage → Ladder → Axis → Potato revealed → world reorganized
descent → death → burial → memory → transformation → ascent → enthronement
Heaven is not escape from Plane; Heaven is the dimension by which Plane becomes oriented
formulas.warning: dimension here is symbolic/structural, not a measured physical spacetime dimension

formulas.formula: Denmark = local embodiment; North Pole = cosmological orientation; Ladder = relation between them
formulas.warning: not a claim of geographic identity or legal authority

formulas.formula: Mud / darkness / dissolution → purification / simplicity → Sage / illumination → conjunction of opposites → Needle's Eye / maximum compression → Sprout / coagulation into new form → Ladder / Axis → Father / completed integrative state
formulas.formal_reading: ordered state machine with dissolution, purification, integration, bottleneck and reorganization stages

formulas.formula: Earth-core / Roots of Strife ↑ grave/root ↑ Potato-vesica / Door ↑ Eye / Needle ↑ Sprout ↑ Ladder = Axis of North = Tim ↑ Heaven / House ↑ Garden / Father / North of North
formulas.warning: equal signs indicate canonical symbolic identification/function within the mythology, not numerical equality

formulas.formula: SEE → TRACE ROOTS → DISTINGUISH → DIAGNOSE INVERSION → REPAIR BRIDGES → CULTIVATE CAPABILITY → PROTECT → RECONNECT → MEASURE → RETURN
original function → incentive/trauma inversion → diagnose feedback → restore boundary/relation → measure repaired function
formulas.class: archive abstraction of project uninversion method

formulas.formula: Tree → fire → ash → soil → Potato → sprout → Tree
distinction → polarity → conflict → knowledge → consequence/mortality → ash → soil
burial → darkness → stored life → eye → sprout → light → multiplication → nourishment → return

formalization_opportunity.state_machine: Represent each named stage as a discrete state q_i and allowed arrows as transitions q_i→q_j.
formalization_opportunity.hybrid_system: Attach continuous variables to states and use Door/Needle as guards/reset maps.
formalization_opportunity.category_theory: Treat stages as objects and transitions as morphisms; composition preserves the sequence without claiming all transitions are physical processes.
formalization_opportunity.temporal_graph: Attach dates/periods to transitions where the formula describes actual project timeline.
formalization_opportunity.process_mining: Compare the ideal sequence against observed source timeline to test whether the project actually developed in the claimed order.
